name: Swords Dance
description:
A frenetic dance uplifts your fighting spirit. Your movements create the mirage of 2 swords near you. For each mirage, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls. Once per move, when you hit with an attack roll, you may expend up to two mirages to deal additional damage equal to this move's MOVE modifier for each mirage spent.

This move ends when all sword mirages are expended.
higherLevels: Your dance improves, granting you an additional sword mirage at each of levels 5, 10, and 17.
